outcome: accuracy of diagnostic codes for stroke
cohort: Infants born at 37 weeks or more in Sweden between 2009-2018, including those admitted to a neonatal ward in Stockholm County with a confirmed stroke diagnosis (cases) and all other Swedish infants born during those years (controls).
finding: Seizures were common in term-born infants with a perinatal stroke, often requiring multiple anti-seizure medications, with many discharged on medication against national recommendations.
cross-section timing: During neonatal ward admission and at discharge
